name.zh: 仰卧单膝抱胸（托马斯测试）

purpose.zh: 看看胯前面紧不紧，顺便轻轻拉开胯前面
purpose.en: Checks whether the front of your hip is tight while gently stretching it.

text.zh: 两手抱住一边膝盖，另一条腿放松贴地
text.en: Hug one knee with both hands, let the other leg rest long on the floor

text.zh: 看伸直那条腿的大腿会不会离开地面，离开了就是胯前面偏紧。
text.en: Watch whether the straight thigh lifts off the floor. If it does, the front of that hip is tight.

text.zh: 就停在这儿，慢慢喘气，每次呼气再松一点。
text.en: Stay right there, breathe slowly, let go a little more each breath out.

text.zh: 别一下一下往下压，有拉的感觉就够，别拉到疼。
text.en: Don't bounce. A clear stretch is enough, never pain.

commonErrors.zh: 伸直的腿故意使劲压地或抬起
commonErrors.en: Pressing the straight leg down or lifting it on purpose.
Hugging so hard your lower back lifts.

commonErrors.zh: 憋气或一下一下往下压

cautions.zh: 膝盖或胯疼就抱松点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knee or hip hurts, don't hug as tight. Stop if it still hurts.

changes: 动画 r3 是双手一起抱膝（原文「一侧膝盖抱向胸口」未写双手），主口令改为双手抱膝

节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：抱 1.8/停 0.7/松 1.1/歇 0.4 s；口令改成跟呼吸走
